info.name: Girder REST API (Emory Digital Slide Archive) annotation file API
file
Start a new upload or create an empty or link file.

params.name: parentType
params.description: Type being uploaded into.

params.name: parentId
params.description: The ID of the parent.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the file being created.

params.name: size
params.description: Size in bytes of the file.

params.name: mimeType
params.description: The MIME type of the file.

params.name: linkUrl
params.description: If this is a link file, pass its URL instead of size and mimeType using this parameter.

params.name: reference
params.description: If included, this information is passed to the data.process event when the upload is complete.

params.name: assetstoreId
params.description: Direct the upload to a specific assetstore (admin-only).

params.name: uploadExtraParameters
params.description: Arbitrary data to send along with the upload request.

items.docs: Use POST /file/chunk to send the contents of the file.  The data for the first chunk of the file can be included with this query by sending it as the body of the request using an appropriate content-type and with the other parameters as part of the query string.  If the entire file is uploaded via this call, the resulting file is returned.

info.name: Download a file.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the document.

params.name: offset
params.description: Start downloading at this offset in bytes within the file.

params.name: endByte
params.description: If you only wish to download part of the file, pass this as the index of the last byte to download. Unlike the HTTP Range header, the endByte parameter is non-inclusive, so you should set it to the index of the byte one past the final byte you wish to receive.

params.name: contentDisposition
params.description: Specify the Content-Disposition response header disposition-type value.

params.name: extraParameters
params.description: Arbitrary data to send along with the download request.

items.docs: This endpoint also accepts the HTTP "Range" header for partial file downloads.

info.name: Download a file.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the file.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the file.  This is ignored.

params.name: offset
params.description: Start downloading at this offset in bytes within the file.

items.docs: The name parameter doesn't alter the download.  Some download clients save files based on the last part of a path, and specifying the name satisfies those clients.
